This method assumes $t$ represents the true Euclidean distance from the ray origin.
Compute distances to each bounding volume in the union/collection.
Let $d_{content}$ be $\min(d_{min}, \text{distance to contents of top BV})$.
Let $d_{bv}$ be the distance to the new top BV.
Stop if $d_{content} < d_{bv}$ or heap is empty.
